text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I happened to see Agnes Digital
working busily in front of a supermarket.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome-!
We have cheap carrots on sale today-!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're a Trainer from Tracen Academy, right?!
How about some carrots for your trainee horse girl?

text_block_list.name: Supermarket Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the hard work, Digital-chan!
Much appreciated today, too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oops, gotta hurry off to the next gig!
Carried by these legs forged through racing and fangirling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I spotted Agnes Digital
in various different places.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the newly reopened bakery-!
We've got carrot-flavored horse girl pastries!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
'Sup! Delivery from Shunshun-ken!
Here's your carrot ramen, thanks for waiting-!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Here is the latest face powder-!
Cosmetics crafted specially for horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Though of course, horse girl skin is always
utterly breathtaking anyway! Dyehuhu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be working from morning till night.
Curious, I decided to ask her why.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hm, you are... We've been bumping into each other a lot lately,
I wonder if some kind of flag has been raised?
choice_data_list: Why are you doing so many part-time jobs?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fuhihi, thank you so much for asking!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, my long-awaited fave horse girl's
photobook release and autograph session is coming up!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An autograph session is a glorious occasion for my fave!
As a fan, I must dress in attire worthy of the moment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And of course, choosing formal wear tailored perfectly
to the person I'm meeting is my personal motto!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! It's a special event where I get to meet my fave!
When else would one ever dress up to the nines?!
choice_data_list: What kind of horse girl is your fave?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: An angel... no, a goddess...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here, feel free to take this.
It has the date, time, and location of the autograph session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Agnes Digital handed me
was a flyer with detailed information about the autograph session.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Are you wondering why I conveniently happen
to have flyers on hand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuhihi, being able to evangelize anytime, anywhere
is basic otaku etiquette!
choice_data_list: As expected of a horse girl otaku...
Admiration really becomes one's power, huh
Admiration really becomes one's power, huh

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuhihi, being able to evangelize anytime, anywhere
is basic otaku etiquette!
choice_data_list: As expected of a horse girl otaku...
Admiration really becomes one's power, huh
Admiration really becomes one's power, huh

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's both give it our all at the venue!
Aaah... I'm so excited for the big day, I can't sleep~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Impressed by Agnes Digital's passion,
I decided to attend her fave horse girl's autograph session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many people attended the autograph session,
and the horse girl interacted warmly and attentively with each and every fan.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you actually came to the autograph session!
I knew from the start you had potential!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
At the venue, there were celebratory flowers sent by
people who took care of my fave in the past... I'm moved to tears!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Plus, gaining a fellow horse girl otaku comrade—
could there be any greater reward than this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Dyehuhu, no need to be so modest.
You are already a splendid otaku!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The following day, while walking through the central plaza,
I spotted Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How was the autograph session?
It was the pinnacle of preciousness, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Dyehuhu... Now you feel like preparing formal wear
for your fave next time too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Whoops, I need to get back to working hard
so I can afford brand-new formal attire!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's both cheer on our faves to our hearts' content
at the next event as well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For the sake of my faves, I can do anything!
I will overcome any trial thrown my way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha, if this isn't the absolute peak of bliss,
then what is?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the horse girls you train
are also supreme beings who grant me boundless strength.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying that I stan every single
horse girl at Tracen Academy as a group. Fuhihi~♪
